title: Blessed Are Those Who Walk in God's Law
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite traveler walks along a clear, well-maintained path through the hill country toward a sanctuary. His clothing is simple and practical, and he carries a small scroll wrapped in cloth. The path passes between healthy olive trees and terraced fields, with a family working honestly in a nearby vineyard. The traveler pauses to listen to an elder who teaches him to follow God's instruction with the whole heart. In the background, two roads divide around a rocky outcrop: one is straight and well-traveled, while the other winds toward a neglected area. The traveler chooses the straight path, symbolizing the blessing of walking in God's law and seeking Him with the whole heart. His expression conveys both devotion and humility, because he desires to keep God's statutes faithfully and asks not to be put to shame. The scene should communicate the opening stanza's blessings, the importance of seeking God, and the intention to praise Him with an upright heart. Historically plausible Israelite garments, stone paths, scroll materials, olive trees, and natural morning light. No modern objects, visible writing, or fantasy effects.

title: How Can a Young Person Keep a Pure Way?
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a young Israelite man sits in a quiet courtyard beside a low wooden table, carefully studying a parchment scroll under the guidance of a respected elder. His expression is attentive and earnest as he seeks to shape his conduct according to God's word. Nearby, his friends prepare to leave for the marketplace, where dishonest dealings and careless conversation could easily distract him. The young man chooses to continue learning before joining them, demonstrating the desire to hide God's word in his heart and meditate on His precepts. A small oil lamp, clay water vessel, woven mat, and open doorway establish the ancient setting. Through the doorway, a well-kept path leads toward the village, symbolizing a life guided by instruction rather than impulse. Do not depict the scroll as magical or include readable invented writing. The scene should express the joy of learning God's statutes, speaking of them, delighting in them, and remembering them in daily life. Authentic ancient Israelite clothing, parchment, stone architecture, and warm lamplight. No modern books, printed text, or fantasy effects.

title: Open My Eyes to Behold Wondrous Things
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper kneels beside a stone terrace with a scroll open on a low table. He looks toward the sky in prayer, asking God to open his eyes to understand the wonders of divine instruction. Around him, ordinary people move through the settlement, and a few proud officials speak dismissively about those who try to live faithfully. The worshipper's expression is thoughtful and resolute, showing that God's testimonies are his delight and counselors even when influential people criticize him. In the distance, a narrow road leads through cultivated fields toward a sanctuary, suggesting a path of understanding that requires patience and attention. Soft sunlight falls across the scroll and the worshipper's face. The scene should convey the contrast between humble seeking and proud contempt, without portraying the criticism as a specific historical event. Ancient Israelite robes, realistic parchment, stone walls, olive trees, and natural light. No modern reading glasses, printed words, visible captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Revive Me According to Your Word
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper sits low on a stone step beside a dusty road, weary from distress and in need of renewed strength. His head is bowed, and his hands are open in prayer as he asks God to revive him according to His word. A trusted companion sits nearby, listening without judgment. Beyond them, the land appears dry and the path difficult, reflecting the psalm's image of a soul clinging to the dust. In the next part of the composition, the path opens toward a small stream flowing between stones and a green patch of pasture, symbolizing the strengthening and widened steps the worshipper hopes to receive. The man slowly rises, steadies himself, and continues along the path with a more settled expression. This is a symbolic portrayal of inward renewal, not a claim of a particular physical illness or miraculous healing. Use realistic ancient clothing, dusty terrain, water, and natural afternoon light. No modern medical equipment, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Teach Me, Give Me Understanding, and Turn My Eyes from Vanity
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite learner stands at a fork in a narrow village street. One route leads toward a busy marketplace where merchants display tempting goods and several people chase prestige through boastful conversation. The other leads toward a quiet courtyard where an elder studies a scroll and welcomes the learner to sit and receive instruction. The learner looks thoughtfully at both paths before turning toward the place of teaching, asking God to instruct him in His statutes, give him understanding, incline his heart toward faithful obedience, and turn his eyes away from empty things. Near the courtyard, a merchant offers a fine ornament, but the learner declines politely and continues to the scroll. The scene should convey moral direction and inward discipline rather than condemning all trade or material goods. Historically plausible garments, market baskets, pottery, parchment, stone architecture, and natural daylight. No modern consumer items, visible writing, or fantasy effects.

title: I Will Speak of Your Testimonies Before Kings
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper stands before an assembly that includes elders, local officials, and travelers from neighboring communities. He wears modest but clean clothing and holds a carefully wrapped parchment scroll. His face reflects confidence grounded in God's steadfast love rather than personal status. An influential man questions his convictions, but the worshipper answers calmly and truthfully, prepared to speak of God's testimonies even before people of authority. Other listeners respond with curiosity and respect. In the background, a sanctuary courtyard and a broad road leading toward a royal residence suggest both worship and public life. The worshipper's free, open gestures express delight in God's commandments and the desire to meditate on them continually. Do not depict the scene as a documented royal audience or place readable words on the scroll. Use ancient Israelite garments, stone architecture, woven curtains, and natural light. No modern podiums, printed books, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Your Word Has Been My Comfort in Affliction
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a solitary Israelite traveler rests beside a stone wall during the evening after a difficult day. He holds a small wrapped scroll close to his chest and reflects on the hope contained in God's promise. A few people in the nearby street mock him for maintaining his faith, while an older companion remains beside him in quiet support. The traveler's face shows that he is still afflicted, yet his posture is steadier because divine instruction has been his comfort and song. Beyond the wall, a clear path leads toward the sanctuary, and oil lamps begin to glow in the surrounding homes. The scene should also suggest that remembering God's name and keeping His law have become a constant practice in the worshipper's life. Avoid portraying mockery as a specific documented event or suggesting that sorrow has instantly vanished. Historically plausible robes, scroll materials, limestone walls, and gentle evening light. No modern objects, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Is My Portion; I Have Promised to Keep His Words
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite farmer stands at the boundary of a modest inheritance marked by low stones and olive trees. His land is not expansive, but he looks across it with gratitude and contentment, expressing the conviction that the LORD is his portion. Nearby, a neighbor arrives with a request to borrow a tool, and the farmer agrees promptly, demonstrating faithful conduct and kindness. In a nearby courtyard, a group of travelers speaks about God's laws and mercy, while night settles over the hills and oil lamps are lit in the homes. The farmer pauses beside a table with a wrapped scroll, recalling that he has promised to keep God's words and has risen even at midnight to give thanks. The scene should convey devotion expressed in practical life, generosity, and gratitude, rather than material ownership as the main blessing. Use historically plausible agricultural tools, stone boundaries, woven clothing, clay lamps, and natural twilight. No modern farming equipment, visible writing, or fantasy effects.

title: It Is Good That I Was Afflicted, That I Might Learn Your Statutes
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite learner sits with a respected elder in a simple courtyard, reflecting on lessons learned during a difficult season. A walking staff and travel cloak lie nearby, suggesting that the learner has passed through hardship and is now seeking wisdom. The elder opens a scroll and points to a passage while the learner listens with humility. In the background, a wealthy but arrogant man walks through the marketplace, relying on his status, while a modest worker treats a neighbor honestly. The contrast should show the psalmist's recognition that hardship can deepen understanding and that God's instruction is more valuable than great riches. Do not imply that all affliction is sent as punishment or that suffering is inherently good in every circumstance. The learner's expression is thoughtful, neither celebrating pain nor ignoring its seriousness. Authentic ancient Israelite clothing, scroll materials, stone architecture, and natural daylight. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Your Hands Have Made Me and Fashioned Me
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an elderly craftsperson and a younger learner sit together in an ancient Israelite workshop. A proud observer stands apart, making a dismissive gesture, while the humble group remains united in hope. Use realistic clay, pottery tools, parchment, ancient clothing, and warm natural light. No modern workshop tools, readable writing, or fantasy effects.

title: My Soul Faints for Your Salvation, but I Hope in Your Word
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a weary Israelite worshipper waits beside a small oil lamp late at night, his eyes fixed on a narrow doorway through which the dark hills are visible. A parchment scroll lies beside him, carefully preserved despite the difficult circumstances. Outside, hostile people appear in silhouette at a distance, scheming against him, but they do not approach or attack. No modern objects, graphic danger, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Forever, O LORD, Your Word Is Settled in Heaven
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with a majestic landscape beneath an immense, clear sky. title: O How I Love Your Law
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite learner sits beneath an olive tree in a quiet courtyard, deeply absorbed in studying a parchment scroll. In the marketplace beyond the courtyard, a few merchants bargain and local officials discuss a dispute, illustrating the settings in which wisdom can be applied. The learner does not boast about being better than others; his expression shows gratitude that instruction makes him wiser, helps him understand more than his teachers, and gives discernment to reject false ways. title: Your Word Is a Lamp to My Feet
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite traveler walks along a narrow stone path at night, carrying a small oil lamp that illuminates only the ground immediately before him. The traveler pauses to pray, reaffirming his commitment to follow God's righteous judgments despite the dangers of the journey. title: You Are My Hiding Place and My Shield
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper takes shelter beneath a natural rock overhang during unsettled weather. title: I Have Done What Is Just and Right

title: The Entrance of Your Words Gives Light
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite learner sits beside an open doorway at dawn, carefully studying a parchment scroll as natural light enters the room. title: Your Righteousness Is Everlasting

title: Revive Me According to Your Word

title: Great Peace Have They Who Love Your Law
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite worshipper stands quietly in a courtyard while powerful officials speak nearby. title: I Have Gone Astray Like a Lost Sheep
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite shepherd walks through rugged hills at sunset searching for a lost sheep. title: Deliver Me from Lying Lips
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite traveler stands at the edge of an ancient settlement after being harmed by false accusations and hostile speech. Beyond him, distant hills and a road leading away from the town evoke the psalmist's feeling of living among people who love conflict while he desires peace.
